topic_title: Traffic Control Devices: Legal Foundation & Enforcement
prompt: What constitutes the legal violation of 'running a red light' under Texas traffic statutes?

options.text: Being inside an intersection when the signal changes from yellow to red
Making a complete stop and then turning right on red where permitted
Entering an intersection after the signal facing you has turned red
Proceeding through a green signal while crossing pedestrians are on sidewalk
